about.title: About this site
about.text1: This site is my professional portfolio: it presents my background, skills and projects in a clear, structured way.
about.text2: It can also be viewed at any time as a classic résumé, printable and downloadable in one click, via the toggle in the navigation bar.
about.text3: The goal is simple: give a recruiter or a company a quick, reliable overview of my profile, without detours.

uclouvain.title: Full-Stack Python Django Developer
uclouvain.description: Development and maintenance of Django web applications (back-end and front-end). Built from scratch a student evaluation registration system (API and interfaces), evaluation organization, credit allocation for student registration, redesign of the student record interface, generation of 10 different PDFs (course plan composition, evaluation registration, deliberation minutes, etc.) and data migration scripts. Approach: Domain Driven Design.
